# UISet

> Themes, components, kits and templates for Vercel's UI SDK, installed with the shadcn CLI. Behavior (keyboard, focus, ARIA, agent access) comes from UI SDK; UISet adds the skins, sound and haptics, and the kits apps are made of. React, and Web Components for every other framework.

Rules for agents building with UISet:

- Wrap the app (or a part of it) in `<UISet skin="base">` from `@/components/ui/uiset`. Every UISet and UI SDK component inside takes the skin.
- Install items with `npx shadcn@latest add @uiset/<item>`; they land in `components/ui/` and import each other relatively.
- Don't hand-write keyboard handling, focus traps or ARIA roles that a UI SDK component or behavior covers. Read the installed UI SDK docs at `node_modules/@ui-sdk/react/docs/llms.txt`.
- Give every control a name (a label, `aria-label`, or `label` prop): UI SDK's agent bridge finds components by it.
- Skins set CSS variables; style your own parts with `var(--ui-foreground)`, `var(--ui-muted-foreground)`, `var(--ui-border)`, `var(--ui-primary)` and friends, so they follow every skin.

## Docs

- [Overview and every item](https://uiset.dev/docs/README.md): what each item is and where its docs are
- [Introduction](https://uiset.dev/docs/introduction.md): What UISet is, how it relates to UI SDK and shadcn/ui, and what's in it
- [Installation](https://uiset.dev/docs/installation.md): Add UISet with the shadcn CLI, load each skin's fonts, or use the Web Components build
- [Quick start](https://uiset.dev/docs/quick-start.md): A working settings screen in a few minutes
- [Building with AI agents](https://uiset.dev/docs/ai.md): The skills and llms.txt for coding agents, and UI SDK's agent bridge for agents that use your app
- [Looking for a component?](https://uiset.dev/docs/looking-for.md): Where the components people ask for most are in UISet: calendar, time picker, multi-select, dropzone, table and more
- [Web Components](https://uiset.dev/docs/web-components.md): Every kit and template as custom elements, for plain HTML, Vue, Svelte and Solid
- [Vue](https://uiset.dev/docs/vue.md): UISet in a Vue 3 app, through the Web Components build
- [Svelte](https://uiset.dev/docs/svelte.md): UISet in a Svelte 5 app, through the Web Components build
- [Templates](https://uiset.dev/docs/templates.md): Whole pages built only from UISet items
- [Theming](https://uiset.dev/docs/theming.md): Skins, the key color, dark mode, nesting, sound and haptics, and the theme builder
- [Coming from shadcn/ui](https://uiset.dev/docs/migrate-from-shadcn.md): What maps to what, and how to move a shadcn/ui app over
- [Agent migration recipe](https://uiset.dev/docs/agent-migration.md): Steps a coding agent follows to move a shadcn/ui app to UISet, with a check after each step
- [Roadmap](https://uiset.dev/docs/roadmap.md): What's shipped, what's next, and how UISet follows UI SDK

## UI SDK components

- [Every UI SDK component's API and keys](https://ui-sdk.dev/docs): UISet installs each as its own item (`button`, `switch`, `slider`, `segmented-control`, `select`, `field`, `dialog`, `tabs`, `accordion`, `alert-dialog`, `autocomplete`, `avatar`, `calendar`, `carousel`, `checkbox`, `collapsible`, `color-picker`, `combobox`, `command`, `date-input`, `date-picker`, `drawer`, `file-input`, `hover-card`, `image-cropper`, `input`, `label`, `listbox`, `menu`, `menubar`, `meter`, `navigation-menu`, `number-input`, `otp-input`, `pagination`, `password-input`, `popover`, `preferences`, `progress`, `radio`, `rating`, `resizable`, `scroll-area`, `separator`, `textarea`, `time-input`, `timeline`, `toast`, `toggle`, `token-input`, `toolbar`, `tooltip`, `tree`, `trigger-menu`, `waterfall`)
